1.sahih_international: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
1.yusuf_ali: For the covenants (of security and safeguard enjoyed) by the Quraish,
1.shakir: For the protection of the Qureaish--
1.muhammad_sarwar: For God's favors to them during their summer and winter journeys,
1.mohsin_khan: (It is a great Grace and Protection from Allah), for the taming of the Quraish,

2.sahih_international: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
2.pickthall: For their taming (We cause) the caravans to set forth in winter and summer.
2.yusuf_ali: Their covenants (covering) journeys by winter and summer,-
2.shakir: Their protection during their trading caravans in the winter and the summer--
2.muhammad_sarwar: Quraish should worship the Lord of this House.
2.mohsin_khan: (And with all those Allah's Grace and Protections for their taming, We cause) the (Quraish) caravans to set forth safe in winter (to the south), and in summer (to the north without any fear),
2.arberry: their composing for the winter and summer caravan!

3.sahih_international: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
3.pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
3.yusuf_ali: Let them adore the Lord of this House,
3.shakir: So let them serve the Lord of this House
3.muhammad_sarwar: It is He who has fed them when they were hungry
3.mohsin_khan: So let them worship (Allah) the Lord of this House (the Ka'bah in Makkah).
3.arberry: So let them serve the Lord of this House

4.sahih_international: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
4.pickthall: Who hath fed them against hunger and hath made them safe from fear.
4.yusuf_ali: Who provides them with food against hunger, and with security against fear (of danger).
4.shakir: Who feeds them against hunger and gives them security against fear.
4.muhammad_sarwar: and has made them secure from fear.
4.mohsin_khan: (He) Who has fed them against hunger, and has made them safe from fear.
4.arberry: who has fed them against hunger and secured them from fear.
